description: Read-only status check for the per-solet macOS LaunchAgent. Reports whether the plist exists, whether launchd knows the label, prior/current state, last observed run time if available, and the resolved plist path. No state is mutated.
embedding_description: Read macOS LaunchAgent autostart status for the local solet. Reports installed_loaded, installed_not_loaded, not_installed, or failed; includes verb, solet_name, label, plist_path, prior_state, last_run_at, dry_run, and message. Read-only diagnostic for login-time autostart wiring.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: AutostartResult envelope with status, verb, solet_name, label, plist_path, prior_state, last_run_at, dry_run, and message.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with status. installed_loaded is the expected configured state. not_installed means login-time autostart is absent. installed_not_loaded means the plist exists but launchd does not currently know the label.

error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: Failures usually indicate launchctl status errors or filesystem access problems.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If status fails, inspect launchctl list for the label and verify the plist path under ~/Library/LaunchAgents.
